card.name: Dementia and elderly-care context words
card.fires_on: Words that come right after dementia, Alzheimer's or elderly-patient wording, mostly the word psychosis in 'dementia-related psychosis' and its capitalised, split-up spellings. Also words in elderly nursing-home or Alzheimer's care sentences.

modes.label: Dementia-related psychosis
modes.description: The word psychosis, or the letters inside it, after 'dementia-related' in warnings and indications.
